hardware: one on-demand NVIDIA H200 (environment.txt); both teachers trained side by side, then the student

teachers.architecture: pre-activation ResNet, widths 160-320-640, blocks 4-4-4, no SE (WideResNet-28-10 scale)
teachers.recipe: round 2 augmentation (TrivialAugment, CutMix/MixUp 0.5, no erasing), no distillation, 250 epochs, --allow-over-budget

student.recipe: exact R9 recipe; teachers are R9's ten plus T_wide_s1 and T_wide_s2

notes: train.py, tests/test_training.py and scripts/balance.py in this commit match the VM copies in vm-manifest.sha256.
The teacher logs begin with the CIFAR-10 download progress line.
Checkpoints are not in the repository: T_wide_s1/s2 are 280 MB training checkpoints and R11_wide a 38 MB training checkpoint; their SHA-256 values are in vm-manifest.sha256.
